about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; the result still has to pass `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm lint`.

evals.prompt: Model an order that can be draft, submitted, shipped with a tracking number, or cancelled with a reason, and write a function that returns a label for each.

expect.why: A discriminated union with a literal tag.
Data that only exists in one state lives in that variant.

reject.why: Boolean flags instead of a union.

evals.prompt: Parse the JSON body of the payment provider's webhook: it has an event type (paid or refunded), an invoice id and an amount in cents.

expect.why: The body is parsed with a valibot schema.
The event type is a closed set.
The id is branded at the edge.
The type is derived from the schema, not written twice.

reject.why: Casting unparsed JSON instead of parsing it.

evals.prompt: Create a packages/types workspace package with our Invoice and Customer types and use it from the web app.

expect.why: A source-only internal package exports its TypeScript through exports.
The package extends the shared strict config.
The app depends on it with the workspace protocol.
Types are imported with import type.

reject.why: Strict flags are never loosened per package.
No build step for a source-only internal package.
